limitations_and_boundaries: The equality constrained program is nonconvex, so only stationary points are guaranteed.
Relies on smooth score functions; non-smooth or discrete scores require further work.
Computational complexity is cubic in the number of nodes due to matrix exponential.
Fixed thresholding parameter ω is suboptimal; data-driven choice is future work.
No worst-case iteration complexity results established.

Compare NOTEARS solution quality to exact global minimizer on small graphs.
Develop an augmented Lagrangian algorithm to solve the constrained program.

methods.name: NOTEARS
methods.protocol_description: Minimize least-squares loss F(W) subject to h(W)=0, where h(W)=tr(e^{W∘W})-d. Solve via augmented Lagrangian with L-BFGS (λ=0) or proximal quasi-Newton (λ>0). Post-process with hard thresholding at ω=0.3.

methods.name: FGS (GES)
methods.protocol_description: Fast Greedy Search implementation of Greedy Equivalent Search, a score-based combinatorial search method.

methods.name: LiNGAM
methods.protocol_description: Linear non-Gaussian acyclic model for causal discovery.
